title: Children Refusing Contact: Understanding the Child’s Perspective
description: This course helps fathers understand why children may refuse contact after separation, conflict, or experiences of harm. It focuses on child safety, emotional needs, trauma responses, and how fathers can rebuild trust through consistent, safe, and child‑centred behaviour.
learningOutcomes: Understand the common reasons children refuse contact after conflict or harm.
Recognise trauma responses and emotional needs in children.
Learn how to respond safely, calmly, and without pressure.
Develop strategies to rebuild trust through consistent, child‑centred behaviour.

modules.title: Why Children Refuse Contact
modules.content: Explores emotional, developmental, and safety‑related reasons children withdraw from a parent.

modules.title: Understanding Trauma and Fear Responses
modules.content: Examines how past experiences, conflict, or instability shape a child’s reactions.

modules.title: Rebuilding Trust Safely
modules.content: Provides practical steps for fathers to reconnect in a safe, patient, and child‑centred way.
